caption: Aars Church, Aars
composition: The parish church beside a small paved square · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Aars Church stands beside a small paved square: exposed brick and granite beside whitewashed later work, red tile on the nave, copper on a low tower and the apse, and a small ridge turret, with a few early-autumn trees. The square is empty. It is partly cloudy, about 9.6°C. The wind is light, about 8.3 km/h. Broken cloud partly veils the low morning sun. Shop fronts are out of the frame. The town spells its name Aars.
